name: ed25519_fast
description: libsodium ref10 ed25519 verification plus a batch verifier, built as one translation unit so the field arithmetic can inline. ed25519_fast.c is the only C file compiled directly; it #includes the rest. It also carries the precomputed-table entry points: lc_ed25519_verify_pre() takes the eight odd multiples of the public key instead of rebuilding them, which is 9.4% of a verification on an ESP32 and changes no accept/reject decision - tools/gen_checkpoint.py emits the tables, test/run_pre.sh checks them against ref10's own arithmetic. fe25519_mul_xtensa.S is a handwritten Xtensa fe25519_mul, generated by tools/gen_fe25519_mul.py from ref10's own term table and used only when LC_FE25519_ASM is defined; without it the file assembles to an unreferenced symbol the linker drops. The optimisation level is deliberately NOT set here - the benchmark environments in platformio.ini pick it, because on this chip it is a variable worth measuring rather than a setting worth assuming.
